title: Trying drums, trombone and tuba before settling on bass
summary: His father bought him many instruments; he tried drums, trombone and baritone horn, and a man showed him that bass-horn and bass-violin clefs are the same, before he returned to bass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
